name: Eopteranodon
isnote: Has been placed in Chaoyangopteridae and as a basal tapejaromorph; most recent analyses place it in Tapejaridae.
sum: Small crested, toothless tapejarid from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China.
wsnote: About 1.1 m; a second specimen was larger.
material: Incomplete skeleton and skull (skull under 20 cm).
biology: Toothless beak and large crest; tapejarids are thought to have included fruit and seeds in their diet.
author: Lü and Zhang 2005
